candidates.name: San Andreas County Roleplay
candidates.description: An English-speaking vMenu community with public civilian and community-officer roleplay, structured emergency-service departments, player businesses and certified gangs. The county also supports car meets, racing and social activities, with published scene-consent rules, support tickets and an appeals route.

inclusionReasons: Explicitly requested community with exact official website, Cfx and Discord identity agreement.
Documented newcomer paths, department structure, scene consent and support/appeals.
Historical public-Cfx monitoring exceeds roughly 35 during normal active sessions; current quiet morning snapshot does not establish inactivity.
Current scripts support emergency services, business/social activities and community-specific resources; functionality not independently playtested.
conflicts: Public flag and public-officer advertising support public entry, while homepage mentions clearance/whitelist updates; those may refer to department access. Confirm any universal Discord-verification step before calling entry unrestricted.
Framework detection sees mixed resources; official title and description explicitly advertise vMenu, so use that player-facing choice.
Paid donor privileges can include weapons/explosives; do not label cosmetic-only or no-pay-to-win.
No independent player review was robust enough to establish consistent enforcement or guarantee friendliness.
Site development page has only two current public release entries; source claim of weekly updates has not been independently corroborated.

redline.name: Redline RP (whitelisted)
redline.description: A whitelisted English-speaking roleplay community centred on character progression and connected storylines, with civilian businesses, emergency services and criminal paths. Its current 2.0 rules prohibit harassment, random violence and metagaming, and direct reports and bugs to the community’s support processes.
